title: HumanStudy protocol v1 (protocol.json)
description: One study as an executable protocol: what each participant saw, in what order, what they could answer, and how the paper analysed it. Frozen 2026-11-08 from DESIGN.md §3/§3.5 and the protocols converted so far. Strict on settled vocabulary (evidence labels, response kinds, back/advance, flow nodes, effect ops/roles); permissive (accepted, reported as undocumented) on notes and study-specific fields. x-legacy-values marks enum values legacy protocols use but DESIGN does not document; x-report-unknown marks objects whose unknown keys are reported. Keys ending in _cite hold a cite, a list of cites or a map of cites; keys named note / *_note are free text never served.

schema_version.description: protocol format version; absent = legacy (pre-v1) file

schema.description: legacy free-form tag (hsenv-protocol/0.1, /3.2 …); superseded by schema_version

data.description: optional: the engine defaults it to {} (engine.py Protocol)

keyed.description: answers that make the paper's pattern true (fuzz/self-test only; keys never reach a State)

expr.description: an expression in the hsenv expression language (expr.py), evaluated per participant

dataNode.description: the study's materials, read by expressions (data['story'][v][c]); free-form, but every cite / *_cite inside is checked

note.description: free-text annotation for operators/reviewers; never served

label.description: evidence label: verbatim = transcribed as printed/shown; reported = stated by the source; derived = computed/inferred from cited material; missing = the source does not say (never filled with plausible text)

source.description: key of meta.sources (or a named source file)

read.description: text read off an image; served only when a blind reading agrees (DESIGN §3.5)

region.description: where on the page an image-read text (or a picture) sits: the app renders it from the user's verified copy (DESIGN §3.6)

citeField.x-name: cite (a cite, a list of cites, or a map name -> cite)

richText.description: a data value with its cite and inline emphasis

anyOf.description: a gap: the text is not printed anywhere (text null, cite labelled missing; DESIGN §2 rule 2)

item.description: one content item of a stage

allOf.x-name: response (choice/multi/rank need a non-empty options list)

presentation.description: how the page was shown: plain values only, evidence in presentation_cite

stage.description: one screen (or one part of a page)

anyOf.description: a flow node (DESIGN §3.2); a list is shorthand for {seq: [...]}

arm.description: a sample/arm of the study; a runnable arm cites its n

n_analysed.description: human analysed n of this arm (after the paper's exclusions): the planned agent n (DESIGN §8.2, §8.7)

anyOf.description: legacy bare count without a cite (to be converted)

n_recruited.description: human recruited n of this arm (before the paper's exclusions); with n_analysed it gives the human exclusion rate (DESIGN §8.7)

anyOf.description: legacy bare count without a cite (to be converted)

arm.x-name: arm (cite required unless runnable is false)

allOf.x-name: arm (a runnable arm's n_paper is an integer, or null with n_operator)

applies_to.description: runtime exclusion: the analysis ids (targets/effects) it scopes to; absent = the whole session. Never prose (put prose in scope_note).

target.description: a reported level (Kind A target, DESIGN §8.3)

compute.description: how the effect is computed from unit rows (ops = effects_core.OPS)

effect.description: a contrast scored against the paper (effects.json schema 2 effect)

pendingEffect.description: an effect whose op the engine does not run yet; never scored

analysisExclusion.description: analysis-only exclusion (analysis_exclusions): documented, not run by the engine. applies_to is a list of analysis ids; a plain string is accepted here only for prose scopes in 5 legacy studies (REPORT §3, to be moved to scope_note)

sourceDistribution.description: how a source's participant-facing text reaches users (DESIGN §3.6): hosted = shipped with attribution (CC-BY, CC0, public domain only); link = URL or DOI, text extracted on the user's machine; user = the user supplies the file. Every item is verified by its own text_sha256; sha256 is the builder's file hash, provenance only

heldItem.description: one participant-facing text or image of a non-hosted source, replaced in a release projection by a same-length placeholder

path.description: JSON pointer of the placeholder string (text) or image object (image)

text_sha256.description: sha256 of the NFC-normalised exact served text

box.description: crop box [x0, y0, x1, y1], page-relative, origin top left

distribution.description: present only in a release projection (hsenv.release.project); hsenv.rehydrate removes it once every held item is restored

strict.description: made by a strict projection (the only kind protocol.json may ship as)
